verses.original: Μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία πιστεύετε εἰς τὸν Θεόν καὶ εἰς ἐμὲ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: Mē tarassesthō hymōn hē kardia pisteuete eis ton Theon kai eis eme pisteuete
verses.literal: Do not let your hearts be troubled You believe in God believe in Me as well
verses.literalPt: NÃO se turbe o vosso coração; credes em Deus, crede também em mim.

verses.original: ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ τοῦ Πατρός μου μοναὶ πολλαί εἰσιν εἰ δὲ μή εἶπον ἂν ὑμῖν ὅτι πορεύομαι ἑτοιμάσαι τόπον ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: en tē oikia tou Patros mou monai pollai eisin ei de mē eipon an hymin hoti poreuomai hetoimasai topon hymin
verses.literal: In My Father’s house are many rooms If it were not so would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you
verses.literalPt: Na casa de meu Pai há muitas moradas; se não fosse assim, eu vo-lo teria dito. Vou preparar-vos lugar.

verses.original: καὶ ἐὰν πορευθῶ καὶ ἑτοιμάσω τόπον ὑμῖν πάλιν ἔρχομαι καὶ παραλήμψομαι ὑμᾶς πρὸς ἐμαυτόν ἵνα ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἦτε
verses.transliteration: kai ean poreuthō kai hetoimasō topon hymin palin erchomai kai paralēmpsomai hymas pros emauton hina hopou eimi egō kai hymeis ēte
verses.literal: And if I go and prepare a place for you I will come back and welcome you into My presence so that you also may be where I am
verses.literalPt: E quando eu for, e vos preparar lugar, virei outra vez, e vos levarei para mim mesmo, para que onde eu estiver estejais vós também.

verses.original: καὶ ὅπου ἐγὼ ὑπάγω οἴδατε τὴν ὁδόν
verses.transliteration: kai hopou egō hypagō oidate tēn hodon
verses.literal: You know the way to the place where I am going
verses.literalPt: Mesmo vós sabeis para onde vou, e conheceis o caminho.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Θωμᾶς Κύριε οὐκ οἴδαμεν ποῦ ὑπάγεις πῶς δυνάμεθα τὴν ὁδὸν εἰδέναι
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Thōmas Kyrie ouk oidamen pou hypageis pōs dynametha tēn hodon eidenai
verses.literal: Lord said Thomas we do not know where You are going so how can we know the way
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Tomé: Senhor, nós não sabemos para onde vais; e como podemos saber o caminho?

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ ὁδὸς καὶ ἡ ἀλήθεια καὶ ἡ ζωή οὐδεὶς ἔρχεται πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα εἰ μὴ δι’ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Egō eimi hē hodos kai hē alētheia kai hē zōē oudeis erchetai pros ton Patera ei mē di’ emou
verses.literal: Jesus answered I am the way and the truth and the life No one comes to the Father except . . . through Me
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Eu sou o caminho, e a verdade e a vida; ninguém vem ao Pai, senão por mim.

verses.original: εἰ ἐγνώκειτέ με καὶ τὸν Πατέρα μου ἂν ᾔδειτε ἀπ’ ἄρτι γινώσκετε αὐτὸν καὶ ἑωράκατε αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ei egnōkeite me kai ton Patera mou an ēdeite ap’ arti ginōskete auton kai heōrakate auton
verses.literal: If you had known Me you would know My Father as well From now on you do know Him and have seen Him
verses.literalPt: Se vós me conhecêsseis a mim, também conheceríeis a meu Pai; e já desde agora o conheceis, e o tendes visto.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Φίλιππος Κύριε δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἀρκεῖ ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Philippos Kyrie deixon hēmin ton Patera kai arkei hēmin
verses.literal: Philip said to Him Lord show us the Father and that will be enough for us
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Filipe: Senhor, mostra-nos o Pai, o que nos basta.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Τοσούτῳ χρόνῳ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰμι καὶ οὐκ ἔγνωκάς με Φίλιππε ὁ ἑωρακὼς ἐμὲ ἑώρακεν τὸν Πατέρα πῶς σὺ λέγεις Δεῖξον ἡμῖν τὸν Πατέρα
verses.transliteration: Legei autō ho Iēsous Tosoutō chronō meth’ hymōn eimi kai ouk egnōkas me Philippe ho heōrakōs eme heōraken ton Patera pōs sy legeis Deixon hēmin ton Patera
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . Philip I have been with you all this time and still you do not know Me Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father How can you say Show us the Father
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Jesus: Estou há tanto tempo convosco, e não me tendes conhecido, Filipe? Quem me vê a mim vê o Pai; e como dizes tu: Mostra-nos o Pai?

verses.original: οὐ πιστεύεις ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί ἐστιν τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐγὼ λέγω ὑμῖν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐ λαλῶ ὁ δὲ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ μένων ποιεῖ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ou pisteueis hoti egō en tō Patri kai ho Patēr en emoi estin ta rhēmata ha egō legō hymin ap’ emautou ou lalō ho de Patēr en emoi menōn poiei ta erga autou
verses.literal: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me The words I say to you I do not speak on My own Instead it is the Father dwelling in Me performing His works
verses.literalPt: Não crês tu que eu estou no Pai, e que o Pai está em mim? As palavras que eu vos digo não as digo de mim mesmo, mas o Pai, que está em mim, é quem faz as obras.

verses.original: πιστεύετέ μοι ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρὶ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοί εἰ δὲ μή διὰ τὰ ἔργα αὐτὰ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: pisteuete moi hoti egō en tō Patri kai ho Patēr en emoi ei de mē dia ta erga auta pisteuete
verses.literal: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me or at least . . . . . . believe on account of the works themselves
verses.literalPt: Crede-me que estou no Pai, e o Pai em mim; crede-me, ao menos, por causa das mesmas obras.

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ κἀκεῖνος ποιήσει καὶ μείζονα τούτων ποιήσει ὅτι ἐγὼ πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα πορεύομαι
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin ho pisteuōn eis eme ta erga ha egō poiō kakeinos poiēsei kai meizona toutōn poiēsei hoti egō pros ton Patera poreuomai
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing He will do even greater things than these because I am going to the Father
verses.literalPt: Na verdade, na verdade vos digo que aquele que crê em mim também fará as obras que eu faço, e as fará maiores do que estas, porque eu vou para meu Pai.

verses.original: καὶ ὅ¦τι ἂν αἰτήσητε ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου τοῦτο ποιήσω ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ Υἱῷ
verses.transliteration: kai ho¦ti an aitēsēte en tō onomati mou touto poiēsō hina doxasthē ho Patēr en tō Huiō
verses.literal: And I will do whatever . . . you ask in My name so that the Father may be glorified in the Son
verses.literalPt: E tudo quanto pedirdes em meu nome eu o farei, para que o Pai seja glorificado no Filho.

verses.original: ἐάν τι αἰτήσητέ με ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐγὼ ποιήσω
verses.transliteration: ean ti aitēsēte me en tō onomati mou egō poiēsō
verses.literal: If you ask Me for anything in My name I will do it
verses.literalPt: Se pedirdes alguma coisa em meu nome, eu o farei.

verses.original: Ἐὰν ἀγαπᾶτέ με τὰς ἐντολὰς τὰς ἐμὰς τηρήσετε
verses.transliteration: Ean agapate me tas entolas tas emas tērēsete
verses.literal: If you love Me you will keep My commandments
verses.literalPt: Se me amais, guardai os meus mandamentos.

verses.original: Κἀγὼ ἐρωτήσω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ ἄλλον Παράκλητον δώσει ὑμῖν ἵνα ᾖ μεθ’ ὑμῶν εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
verses.transliteration: Kagō erōtēsō ton Patera kai allon Paraklēton dōsei hymin hina ē meth’ hymōn eis ton aiōna
verses.literal: And I will ask the Father and He will give you another Advocate to be with you forever
verses.literalPt: E eu rogarei ao Pai, e ele vos dará outro Consolador, para que fique convosco para sempre;

verses.original: τὸ Πνεῦμα τῆς ἀληθείας ὃ ὁ κόσμος οὐ δύναται λαβεῖν ὅτι οὐ θεωρεῖ αὐτὸ οὐδὲ γινώσκει ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε αὐτό ὅτι παρ’ ὑμῖν μένει καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν ἔσται
verses.transliteration: to Pneuma tēs alētheias ho ho kosmos ou dynatai labein hoti ou theōrei auto oude ginōskei hymeis ginōskete auto hoti par’ hymin menei kai en hymin estai
verses.literal: the Spirit of truth The world cannot receive Him because it neither sees Him nor knows Him But you do know Him for He abides with you and will be in you
verses.literalPt: O Espírito de verdade, que o mundo não pode receber, porque não o vê nem o conhece; mas vós o conheceis, porque habita convosco, e estará em vós.

verses.original: Οὐκ ἀφήσω ὑμᾶς ὀρφανούς ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ouk aphēsō hymas orphanous erchomai pros hymas
verses.literal: I will not leave you as orphans I will come to you
verses.literalPt: Não vos deixarei órfãos; voltarei para vós.

verses.original: ἔτι μικρὸν καὶ ὁ κόσμος με οὐκέτι θεωρεῖ ὑμεῖς δὲ θεωρεῖτέ με ὅτι ἐγὼ ζῶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ζήσετε
verses.transliteration: eti mikron kai ho kosmos me ouketi theōrei hymeis de theōreite me hoti egō zō kai hymeis zēsete
verses.literal: In a little while the world will see Me no more but you will see Me Because I live you also will live
verses.literalPt: Ainda um pouco, e o mundo não me verá mais, mas vós me vereis; porque eu vivo, e vós vivereis.

verses.original: ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ γνώσεσθε ὑμεῖς ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρί μου καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: en ekeinē tē hēmera gnōsesthe hymeis hoti egō en tō Patri mou kai hymeis en emoi kagō en hymin
verses.literal: On that day you will know that I am in My Father and you are in Me and I am in you
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia conhecereis que estou em meu Pai, e vós em mim, e eu em vós.

verses.original: ὁ ἔχων τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τηρῶν αὐτὰς ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν ὁ ἀγαπῶν με ὁ δὲ ἀγαπῶν με ἀγαπηθήσεται ὑπὸ τοῦ Πατρός μου κἀγὼ ἀγαπήσω αὐτὸν καὶ ἐμφανίσω αὐτῷ ἐμαυτόν
verses.transliteration: ho echōn tas entolas mou kai tērōn autas ekeinos estin ho agapōn me ho de agapōn me agapēthēsetai hypo tou Patros mou kagō agapēsō auton kai emphanisō autō emauton
verses.literal: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father and I will love him and reveal Myself to him
verses.literalPt: Aquele que tem os meus mandamentos e os guarda esse é o que me ama; e aquele que me ama será amado de meu Pai, e eu o amarei, e me manifestarei a ele.

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἰούδας οὐχ ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης Κύριε καὶ τί γέγονεν ὅτι ἡμῖν μέλλεις ἐμφανίζειν σεαυτὸν καὶ οὐχὶ τῷ κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: Legei autō Ioudas ouch ho Iskariōtēs Kyrie kai ti gegonen hoti hēmin melleis emphanizein seauton kai ouchi tō kosmō
verses.literal: Judas (not Iscariot) asked Him Lord why . . . . . . are You going to reveal Yourself to us and not to the world
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhe Judas (não o Iscariotes): SENHOR, de onde vem que te hás de manifestar a nós, e não ao mundo?

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἐάν τις ἀγαπᾷ με τὸν λόγον μου τηρήσει καὶ ὁ Πατήρ μου ἀγαπήσει αὐτόν καὶ πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐλευσόμεθα καὶ μονὴν παρ’ αὐτῷ ποιησόμεθα
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen autō Ean tis agapa me ton logon mou tērēsei kai ho Patēr mou agapēsei auton kai pros auton eleusometha kai monēn par’ autō poiēsometha
verses.literal: Jesus replied . . . . . . . . . If anyone loves Me he will keep My word My Father will love him and We will come to him and make Our home with him
verses.literalPt: Jesus respondeu, e disse-lhe: Se alguém me ama, guardará a minha palavra, e meu Pai o amará, e viremos para ele, e faremos nele morada.

verses.original: ὁ μὴ ἀγαπῶν με τοὺς λόγους μου οὐ τηρεῖ καὶ ὁ λόγος ὃν ἀκούετε οὐκ ἔστιν ἐμὸς ἀλλὰ τοῦ πέμψαντός με Πατρός
verses.transliteration: ho mē agapōn me tous logous mou ou tērei kai ho logos hon akouete ouk estin emos alla tou pempsantos me Patros
verses.literal: Whoever does not love Me does not keep My words The word that you hear is not My own but it is from the Father who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Quem não me ama não guarda as minhas palavras; ora, a palavra que ouvistes não é minha, mas do Pai que me enviou.

verses.original: Ταῦτα λελάληκα ὑμῖν παρ’ ὑμῖν μένων
verses.transliteration: Tauta lelalēka hymin par’ hymin menōn
verses.literal: All this I have spoken to you while I am still with you
verses.literalPt: Tenho-vos dito isto, estando convosco.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ Παράκλητος τὸ Πνεῦμα τὸ Ἅγιον ὃ πέμψει ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί μου ἐκεῖνος ὑμᾶς διδάξει πάντα καὶ ὑπομνήσει ὑμᾶς πάντα ἃ εἶπον ὑμῖν ἐγώ
verses.transliteration: ho de Paraklētos to Pneuma to Hagion ho pempsei ho Patēr en tō onomati mou ekeinos hymas didaxei panta kai hypomnēsei hymas panta ha eipon hymin egō
verses.literal: But the Advocate the Holy Spirit whom the Father will send in My name will teach you all things and will remind you of everything . . . I have told you
verses.literalPt: Mas aquele Consolador, o Espírito Santo, que o Pai enviará em meu nome, esse vos ensinará todas as coisas, e vos fará lembrar de tudo quanto vos tenho dito.

verses.original: Εἰρήνην ἀφίημι ὑμῖν εἰρήνην τὴν ἐμὴν δίδωμι ὑμῖν οὐ καθὼς ὁ κόσμος δίδωσιν ἐγὼ δίδωμι ὑμῖν μὴ ταρασσέσθω ὑμῶν ἡ καρδία μηδὲ δειλιάτω
verses.transliteration: Eirēnēn aphiēmi hymin eirēnēn tēn emēn didōmi hymin ou kathōs ho kosmos didōsin egō didōmi hymin mē tarassesthō hymōn hē kardia mēde deiliatō
verses.literal: Peace I leave with you My peace I give to you I do not give to you as the world gives Do not let your hearts be troubled do not be afraid
verses.literalPt: Deixo-vos a paz, a minha paz vos dou; não vo-la dou como o mundo a dá. Não se turbe o vosso coração, nem se atemorize.

verses.original: ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἐγὼ εἶπον ὑμῖν Ὑπάγω καὶ ἔρχομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς εἰ ἠγαπᾶτέ με ἐχάρητε ἄν ὅτι πορεύομαι πρὸς τὸν Πατέρα ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ μείζων μού ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: ēkousate hoti egō eipon hymin Hypagō kai erchomai pros hymas ei ēgapate me echarēte an hoti poreuomai pros ton Patera hoti ho Patēr meizōn mou estin
verses.literal: You heard Me say I am going away and I am coming back to you If you loved Me you would rejoice that I am going to the Father because the Father is greater than I
verses.literalPt: Ouvistes que eu vos disse: Vou, e venho para vós. Se me amásseis, certamente exultaríeis porque eu disse: Vou para o Pai; porque meu Pai é maior do que eu.

verses.original: καὶ νῦν εἴρηκα ὑμῖν πρὶν γενέσθαι ἵνα ὅταν γένηται πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: kai nyn eirēka hymin prin genesthai hina hotan genētai pisteusēte
verses.literal: And now I have told you before it happens so that when it does happen you will believe
verses.literalPt: Eu vo-lo disse agora antes que aconteça, para que, quando acontecer, vós acrediteis.

verses.original: Οὐκέτι πολλὰ λαλήσω μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἔρχεται γὰρ ὁ τοῦ κόσμου ἄρχων καὶ ἐν ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔχει οὐδέν
verses.transliteration: Ouketi polla lalēsō meth’ hymōn erchetai gar ho tou kosmou archōn kai en emoi ouk echei ouden
verses.literal: I will not speak with you much longer for the prince of this world is coming and he has no claim . . . on Me
verses.literalPt: Já não falarei muito convosco, porque se aproxima o príncipe deste mundo, e nada tem em mim;

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ἵνα γνῷ ὁ κόσμος ὅτι ἀγαπῶ τὸν Πατέρα καὶ καθὼς ἐνετείλατο μοι ὁ Πατὴρ οὕτως ποιῶ Ἐγείρεσθε ἄγωμεν ἐντεῦθεν
verses.transliteration: all’ hina gnō ho kosmos hoti agapō ton Patera kai kathōs eneteilato moi ho Patēr houtōs poiō Egeiresthe agōmen enteuthen
verses.literal: But I do - exactly what the Father has commanded Me so that the world may know that I love the Father Get up Let us go on from here
verses.literalPt: Mas é para que o mundo saiba que eu amo o Pai, e que faço como o Pai me mandou. Levantai-vos, vamo-nos daqui.
